title: JavaPractice learning workspace
question: Choose the workspace direction, or keep the proposed learning lab.

options.label: The learning lab
options.thesis: A calm science-lab workbook where code and reasoning sit side by side.

options.risk: Needs careful mobile stacking to keep code readable.

canonCard.label: Familiar course dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional course sidebar and lesson cards.
